newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank in merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank in merger deal.

text.p: Japan's Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd and Hokkaido Bank Ltd will merge, Hokkaido Bank Ltd president Tsuneo Fujita confirmed on Tuesday.
He said the two banks would hold a news conference at 10 a.m. (0100 GMT) to formally announce the deal. He gave no further details.

The financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the deal would be a stock swap at an undetermined ratio, with the larger Hokkaido Takushoku the surviving entity. It said a new name had not been determined.
The newspaper said the merger was aimed at streamlining domestic operations of both banks while shedding Hokkaido Takushoku's overseas dealings.
Hokkaido Takushoku is Japan's 10th-largest city bank but has been facing serious loan loss problems. A merger of some type had been expected by industry analysts to help shore up its balance sheet.
